facts.text: Coffee, a lot of it. I'm not sleeping tonight, and neither is anyone who wants to stay safe.
facts.why: Nancy never says this. Only the first page of the quote list could be read, but nothing there or in the plot summary matches. The plot says she relies on caffeine and asks Glen to watch over her. Printed in quote marks and signed Nancy, so it counts as a quote.

facts.text: Marge's nightcap is vodka. This isn't.
facts.why: Marge is shown as an alcoholic, but the sources opened never say what she drinks.
facts.fix: Marge's nightcap is a lot stronger. This isn't.

vibe.verdict: Staying awake on coffee is a smart cue, but it is a plain school canteen that hardly touches the dream horror.
